segments.text: Google's magic pointer is Chromebook only. AI pointer brings it to every OS.
Wiggle your mouse or hit a hotkey and a glass morphism overlay appears right next to your cursor. It screenshots whatever you're pointing at and feeds it
to a vision model. Type or speak your question in any of seven languages. Get your answer without switching tabs or copying anything. Bring your own key.
